plugins.name: migration-guard
plugins.description: Static safety analyzer for database schema migrations: flags table-locking, table-rewriting, and data-loss operations (Postgres SQL + Rails/Django/Alembic) and suggests online-safe rewrites.

plugins.name: llm-app-doctor
plugins.description: Static auditor for AI/LLM integration code: flags leaked API keys, prompt-injection sinks, retired/deprecated model IDs, parameters that now 400 on current models, missing generation limits, and prompt-cache busters (Anthropic + OpenAI, Python + JS/TS).

plugins.name: dockerfile-doctor
plugins.description: Static linter for Dockerfile security (root user, :latest tags, secrets in ENV/ARG, ADD misuse, curl|sh) and image bloat / cache problems (apt and pip caches, dependency-install ordering), with concrete fixes.

plugins.name: env-doctor
plugins.description: Reconciles a project's real .env files, the env vars the code actually reads, and the .env.example — flagging un-ignored .env files, missing/undocumented/dead variables, placeholder values, and secrets committed to the example.

plugins.name: regression-finder
plugins.description: Drives an automated, safe `git bisect run` from a known-good ref and a repro command to pinpoint the commit that introduced a regression, then reports the culprit and its diff.

plugins.name: actions-guard
plugins.description: Security linter for GitHub Actions workflows: unpinned third-party actions, pull_request_target pwn requests, ${{ github.event.* }} script injection in run:, missing least-privilege permissions, secret interpolation, and hard-coded credentials.

plugins.name: api-contract-guard
plugins.description: Detects breaking API changes by diffing two schema versions (OpenAPI/Swagger JSON + GraphQL SDL): removed endpoints/types/fields, newly-required inputs, type changes, and removed enum values.
